newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Jan CPI rise slows to 0.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Jan CPI rise slows to 0.2 percent.

text.p: Morocco's consumer prices rose 0.2 percent in January after a 0.4 percent increase in December, the Statistics Directorate said on Tuesday.
The year-on-year increase to January was 3.7 percent, up from 3.0 percent year-on-year to December.
It said medical care costs rose 0.5 percent in January while clothing costs were up 0.4 percent.
The index for January stood at 149.0. The base year for the index set at 100 points is 1989.
